original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹民间社会呼吁看守州长遏制不断升级的社区暴力
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹国家民间社会联盟呼吁看守州长和行政长官优先开展对话与地方和平倡议，以应对全国范围内不断上升的社区暴力。该联盟称，过去三个月湖泊州、琼格莱州、团结州、瓦拉布州和上尼罗州以及鲁文和阿尔耶行政区的社区冲突有所增加。联盟主席将暴力归因于平民中枪支的广泛可得、长期未解决的争端、饥饿和青年失业。该联盟警告称，持续的社区暴力可能破坏南苏丹的政治过渡。

location.raw_text: Lakes, Jonglei, Unity, Warrap and Upper Nile states, as well as Ruweng and Abyei administrative areas

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹国家民间社会联盟呼吁看守州长和行政长官优先开展对话与地方和平倡议
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: South Sudan’s National Civil Society Coalition has urged caretaker governors and chief administrators to prioritize dialogue and local peace initiatives to address rising communal violence across the country.

key_facts.fact: 该联盟称过去三个月湖泊州、琼格莱州、团结州、瓦拉布州和上尼罗州以及鲁文和阿尔耶行政区的社区冲突有所增加
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the coalition said communal conflicts had increased over the past three months in Lakes, Jonglei, Unity, Warrap and Upper Nile states, as well as Ruweng and Abyei administrative areas.

key_facts.fact: 联盟主席将暴力归因于平民中枪支广泛可得、长期未解决的争端、饥饿和青年失业
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Coalition chairperson Bol Deng Bol attributed the violence to the widespread availability of firearms among civilians, long-standing unresolved disputes, hunger and youth unemployment.

key_facts.fact: 该联盟警告持续的社区暴力可能破坏南苏丹的政治过渡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The coalition cautioned that continued communal violence could undermine South Sudan’s political transition as the country prepares for elections.

uncertainties: 社区冲突增加的说法来自南苏丹国家民间社会联盟的声明，尚未获得独立核实
目前仅有一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，缺乏交叉验证
